createTime.description_zh: 分区的创建时间。UNIX时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
createTime.title: Shard的创建时间。Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数。

exclusiveEndKey.description_en: The end of the MD5 hash range
exclusiveEndKey.title: 指定Shard范围的结束值，Shard范围中不包含该值。即 shard 包含MD5值在 [inclusiveBeginKey, exclusiveEndKey) 之间的日志。

inclusiveBeginKey.description_en: The start of the MD5 hash range. The value is included in the MD5 hash range of the shard
inclusiveBeginKey.description_zh: Shard起始的Key值，在Shard MD5范围中包含该值
inclusiveBeginKey.title: 指定Shard范围的起始值，Shard范围中包含该值。即 shard 包含MD5值在 [inclusiveBeginKey, exclusiveEndKey) 之间的日志。

status.description_en:
The status of the shard. After you create a shard, the shard enters the readwrite state. If you split a shard or merge shards, the shard status changes to readonly. The newly generated shards are in the readwrite state. The status of a shard does not affect the performance of read operations that are performed on the shard. Data can be written to the shards that are in the readwrite state, but data cannot be written to the shards that are in the readonly state. Valid values:

readwrite
readonly
status.description_zh:
Shard状态。创建Shard时，所有Shard状态均为readwrite状态。执行分裂或合并操作后，Shard状态变更为readonly，并生成新的readwrite状态的Shard。Shard状态不影响其数据读取的性能。readwrite状态的Shard可保证数据写入性能，readonly状态的Shard不提供数据写入服务。取值包括：

readwrite（读写）
readonly（只读）
status.title: shard 的读写状态，readwrite 或者 readonly。
